 Appearance:

High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Pramod Kumar Sahu - Advocate for applicant.

Shri Santosh Yadav - Government Advocate for respondent No.
 Order

This is repeat (second) bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.910/2024 dated 27.12.2024 registered at Police Station Gorakhpur, District Jabalpur for the offences under Sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(D)(a), 384 of IPC and Sections 3/4, 5g/6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(i)w(i),
3(i)w(ii), 3(2)v of SC/ST Act.

2. Earlier bail application of the present applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 25.02.2025 passed in M.Cr.C.No.7325/2025.
3.
Counsel for the applicant contends that after dismissal of previous application charge sheet in the matter has been filed.
It is contended by the counsel for applicant that apparently allegations are false and baseless inasmuch as there is no seizure of any kind of obscene video from any mobile.
It is being alleged that obscene video was sent to brother of victim also but even, there is complete failure on the part of the prosecution to produce any video clip.
Applicant's past is unblemished.
In such circumstances, applicant deserves to be NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:16942 2 MCRC-15333-2025 enlarged on bail as he is aged about 21 years and he is in custody since 30.01.2025.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra , counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the said application and submitted that offence has been committed against a minor, therefore, applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

5. Heard the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and perused the case diary.
6.

Taking into consideration all facts and circumstances of the case, the facts that past record of applicant is unblemished, he is in custody since 30.01.2025, charge sheet in the matter has been filed and looking to the age of applicant, this Court deems it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
9 . C.C. today.

(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE vc Shubham Chandrawanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57075138/
